profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Matterport
profile.summary: A Full Stack Engineer with 10+ years of professional experience leading agile development teams. Passionate about software development and working with new technologies. Enjoys creating innovative solutions to complex problems using a client comes first mentality. Strives to optimize the client experience through data driven decisions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered and supported Matterport's e-commerce UI platform, optimizing the user purchase journey and reducing technical debt.
- Led technical investigations and root-cause analysis for high-priority, customer-facing issues
- Engineered a scalable React UI layer to replace outdated legacy systems, significantly reducing technical debt and streamlining the developer workflow.
- Integrated analytics tooling to monitor user journeys, leverage product metrics, and validate design hypotheses through experimentation.
- Partnered across product, design, and engineering teams to build customer-centric web solutions, improving overall customer experience.

positions.title: Senior Technical Lead
positions.description: Lead a team of junior and entry level developers that create web-based products to serve our client’s needs. Enforce code quality, performance, and security best practices. Provide architectural direction and leading investigations of new integrations. Collaborating with business partners to understand requirements and negotiations.  Coaching and assisting developers through technical issues.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Implemented an application that allows clients to upgrade their accounts to
Vanguard’s brokerage platform (Angular, Express.js, PCF)
- Implemented complex Node.js middleware that allowed clients to submit
multiple account upgrades to brokerage platform
- Implemented Spring Boot webservice that determined account upgrade
eligibility
- Integrated with internal record keeping systems for compliance purposes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Modernized one of Vanguard’s most used web application using AngularJS
and hosted in a PCF runtime
- Supported technical leadership in architectural decisions and investigations
- Mentored junior developers on implementation security best practices

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: Federal contractor working on a team of engineers to implement and maintain automated test cases for the National Institutes of Health website for regression purposes. Transitioned the team from using Rational Functional Tester to Selenium scripts.

positions.title: BD-J Developer
positions.description: Implemented and tested Blu-ray Disc menus which allow users to interact with the video content available on the disc.  Worked with big name clients, such as: Fox, Paramount, and Universal.  Implemented titles: The Girls Next Door (US) and X-Men Origins: Wolverine (Region B).
